title: Japanese-Style Keto Tofu Kaiseki Course
description: A unique keto dish featuring a Japanese-inspired tofu course, perfect for a special evening meal.

ingredients.name: creamy
ingredients.notes: keto-friendly cream, such as coconut cream

instructions: 2. Place the cubed tofu on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
3. Drizzle the sesame oil over the tofu and toss to coat.
4. Bake the tofu in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
5. In a small saucepan, heat the keto-friendly sauce over low heat.
6. Add the coconut cream to the saucepan and whisk until combined.
7. To assemble the dish, place a portion of the mixed greens on a plate.
8. Top the greens with a portion of the baked tofu.
9. Drizzle the creamy sauce over the tofu.
